Ab next step — Deploy karein
1. Cloudflare editor mein Ctrl + End press karein, taake code ke bilkul end par chale jayein.
2. Confirm karein ke aakhri lines mein export default function properly close ho raha hai.
3. Top-right blue Deploy button par click karein.
4. Deployment complete hone ka wait karein
